judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Compare cultures of Canada vs US — Pass (1,2,3,4); (2) >=80 words — Pass (all); (3) Include vocab: Square mile, Border, Coastline, Provinces, Language, English-French, Diversity, Married, Children, Education, Art, Cities — Pass (1,2,3), Pass/Partial (4 uses “married” but not exact “Married”). Candidate 1 best balances complete vocab coverage with comparatively fewer dubious specifics; Candidate 2 is also strong but has a weaker/possibly reversed land-area comparison. Candidate 3 includes multiple confident, highly specific numeric “study” claims that are not supportable from the text alone. Candidate 4 contains a likely factual error (“Canada coastline over 150,000 miles”) and additional questionable specifics (e.g., “free tuition”), lowering overall quality.
